verdicts.note: Pole_a explicitly includes mandatory treatment; court-mandated treatment, prosecuting repeat property crime, hard-drug consequences and license plate readers support -2 even though she pairs them with treatment.

Being a first-time candidate is a fact (S1), but she does not campaign on renewal or outsider status, and this is an open seat with no incumbent. Her opponent is also a first-time legislative candidate and is scored +1/medium. The score is a profile inference from one pamphlet line, so medium fits the guide better than high.

One clear statement ('100 percent pro-choice', S2) plus the Planned Parenthood Alliance Advocates endorsement (S1). The pamphlet carries only the endorsement, not a statement. Under the guide that is 'single clear statement or strong endorsement pattern' = medium, not 'record or repeated explicit statements' = high. The +2 score stands.
